name: team-vr

frames.best_why: All three portraits are present and the middle card shows the pink quote overlay and gradient name.

tagline: Team portraits that turn into a warm quote panel when hovered.
summary: A tall dark team section ending in a magenta and orange glow. Three square portraits sit under a bold heading, and hovering one floods it with a hot gradient, a quote mark and a line of white text.
appearance: Black background with a faint square grid and a strong magenta-to-orange wash along the bottom. A tiny uppercase label and a large white heading sit above three rounded square portraits shown in greyscale, each followed by a white name and a small grey role.
behaviour: Cards fade up one at a time when the section scrolls into view. Hovering a portrait pushes a pink-to-orange gradient panel over it with a large quote mark, zooms and colours the photo beneath, and turns the name into a gradient; leaving reverses it.
demo_content: Label "Meet the Team", heading "The Minds behind Social VR", and members Michael Scott, David Brent and Lara Croft.
search_phrases: team cards that reveal a quote on hover
dark team page with pink glow
use_when: A startup or product team page wants portraits that flip into a short mission quote under the pointer.
avoid_when: Light or cool-palette brands: the pink-orange gradient and glow are fixed, and quotes need a cursor to read.
customise: The three people, photos, roles and shared quote are a hardcoded array in the file; the pink-orange palette and glow also need source edits.
weight_why: Three photos and hover CSS; the only running animation is a one-time entrance stagger.

a11y.note: Quotes appear on mouse hover only, so keyboard users never read them; no reduced-motion handling is present.

issues: The same identical quote is pasted on all three members.
Roles are 10px grey text low on the dark background, hard to read.
polish_why: Strong composition and a convincing hover quote panel; tiny roles and repeated quotes let it down.
title: Team VR Section
